Good morning colleagues,
I am reaching out as Sicharge D Expert from Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0451414.
The ticket was opened for issues on charger
MP/R9 170002656.
As I understood from the handover notes, my colleague Francois supported in the past weeks, and State Monitor KF14 was replaced in the charger.
When I got the ticket on Friday, I checked the charger and outlet 1 was out of order. I verified and it seems that the charger could not read the SECC FW installed in the controller (KF12) for DC1. I restarted the SECC, and the issue was solved.
This morning I checked the behavior of the charger over the weekend, and since I rebooted the SECC on Friday afternoon, both outlets are available, performed charging sessions and did not go out of order.
For this reason, the issue is solved and I will proceed to close this ticket. If you experience other issues on this charger, please do not hesitate to open a new ticket.
Thank you for your support, have great start of the week!

additional_info.subject: Keeps in state   preparing
RE: FW: Re: ID0451414-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R9 170002656] Charger is Offline CRM:02084000281
additional_info.body:
God afternoon Bart,
I am following up our conversation on MS Teams for ticket
0451414
. As you reported, outlet DC2 is still not working, and in the ticket you provided me with timestamps to analyze. I apologize for mixing up latest issues on DC1 with original issues on DC2.
I analyzed the logs of failed charging attempts over the weekend, and the DC2 is never able to pass Charging Phase P03_CableCheck. The reason is always the same: the Outgoing Coil QA13-14 are not reporting feedback on, hence contactors are not closing.
When we enter Cablecheck phase, the contactors are commanded to close, but the feedback does not arrive back, resulting in the session failing:
Previously, it was recommended to replace State Monitor KF14, which is a HW controller responsible to command the closure of the contactors.
To restore the charger and solve the issue, it is necessary to go onsite and perform two actions:
Verify the the highlighted connections in yellow below, and then perform an attempt to charge on DC2. It could be that the KF14 and contactors are working perfectly, but the command signal is lost in connector XD10.3A/3B and does not reach the contactors, or the feedback does not reach the PLC.
Since this is a double connector passing from side to side, it happened in the past that a false contact there caused the contactor not to close, or the feedback not to be received.
Please verify the connections and try to charge on DC2. If the QA13-14 are still not closing (most likely), it will be necessary to replace them.
Here are the spare parts to be ordered (2x contactors):
I checked the asset on ISP, and verified that the charger is currently
Out of Warranty
since beginning of September 2025..

additional_info.subject: RE: 0451414 - ID0451414-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R9 170002656] Charger is Offline CRM:02916000032
additional_info.body:
Hello Bart, Hello Sudeep,
I am reaching out for this ticket
ID0451414
for charger
MP/R9 170002646.
After the clarification on the out of warranty support done in the past days, I had the time today to go through all the past history of the ticket, and check the current status of the charger. I will summarize here a few points:
Ticket was originally opened for charger being offline and not reachable on Sifinity
The Second level suggested to replace KF14, but did not report in the ticket any analysis to support this.
As I understand, after replacement of KF14, problems on DC2 started.
In November I analyzed this ticket, and found that the charging on DC2 was failing during P03_Cable Check due to a missing feedback from outgoing contactors QA13-14. I forwarded the following instructions and verification to perform:
Check the connection and configuration of State Monitor
Check the cablings and connections bringing the command from the state monitor tot he contactors and the feedback form contactors to state monitor, to see if any false contact is interrupting the loop
Replace the QA13-14.
From your last emails, I understand that during the last onsite investigations, only the state monitor was replaced, and
the contactors were not replaced. Is it correct?
Also, I do not see any feedback in regards of the first 2 verifications.
I just checked the status of the charger. Over the past week:
Charger is online on Sifinity. The original problem of loss of connection seems resolved
DC1 is performing successfully charging sessions every day
DC2 is failing every session, with the very same symptoms of missing feedback of contactors.
From a technical point of view, the troubleshooting instructions remain the same from my side. But first, I need to understand with Sudeep what has actually been checked and what not.
I will reach out to Sudeep next week as soon as he's back in office.
If the customer claims that the issue originated just after the replacement of KF14, the first thing would be to doublecheck the dip-switches configuration of the State Monitor. Please let me know if this has already been done or not. In any case, here is the dip switches configuration to check:
DC1 has to follow the configuration of the first column (Phoenix 250A), DC2 the configuration of the second column (Phoenix HPC).
Beside this check, I need to verify first with Sudeep precisely which verifications have been done and which component have been already replaced. In the event of the next onsite visit, we could schedule a remote support with me, so that I can personally guide you through the troubleshooting steps.
I will reach out to you asap as soon as I have further information.
With kind regards,
